verses.1: A Canticle Psalm. On the day of the Sabbath.
verses.2: It is good to confess to the Lord and to sing psalms to your name, O Most High:
verses.3: to announce your mercy in the morning, and your truth throughout the night,
verses.4: upon the ten strings, upon the psaltery, with a canticle, upon stringed instruments.
verses.5: For you, O Lord, have delighted me with your doings, and I will exult in the works of your hands.
verses.6: How great are your works, O Lord! Your thoughts have been made exceedingly deep.
verses.7: A foolish man will not know these things, and a senseless one will not understand:
verses.8: when sinners will have risen up like grass, and when all those who work iniquity will have appeared, that they shall pass away, age after age.
verses.9: But you, O Lord, are the Most High for all eternity.
verses.10: For behold your enemies, O Lord, for behold your enemies will perish, and all those who work iniquity will be dispersed.
verses.11: And my horn will be exalted like that of the single-horned beast, and my old age will be exalted in fruitful mercy.
verses.12: And my eye has looked down upon my enemies, and my ear will hear of the malignant rising up against me.
verses.13: The just one will flourish like the palm tree. He will be multiplied like the cedar of Lebanon.
verses.14: Those planted in the house of the Lord will flourish in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.15: They will still be multiplied in a fruitful old age, and they will endure well,
verses.16: so that they may announce that the Lord our God is righteous and that there is no iniquity in him. [ Psalm 92 ] (93)
